name: Nikoh.my
description: A full-stack wedding vendor marketplace focused on the Malaysian market, enabling users to discover, compare, and connect with wedding service providers.
longDescription: Developed a full-stack wedding vendor marketplace using Next.js and Supabase. Integrated Gemini AI to provide personalized wedding planning assistance including budget estimation, guest list management, timeline planning, and vendor recommendations. Included secure auth, and deployed on Vercel with Cloudflare.
highlights: Built a full-stack AI-powered wedding vendor marketplace for the Malaysian market, enabling vendor discovery, comparison, inquiries, and wedding planning.
Integrated Gemini AI to generate personalized wedding plans, including budget estimation, guest planning, timelines, and vendor recommendations.
Implemented authentication, role-based customer/vendor management, database security, and transactional email workflows.
Deployed the application using Vercel, Cloudflare, and Supabase.

topics.architecture: Next.js App Router with Supabase as the primary database and auth layer. Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Resend for transactional emails.
topics.ai: Uses Gemini to process user requirements and provide budget estimation, guest list management, and tailored vendor recommendations.
topics.stack: Next.js, Supabase, JWT, Gemini, Vercel, Cloudflare, Resend.
topics.challenges: Ensuring secure vendor and customer management while handling real-time database operations reliably.

name: Warna Asmara
description: A full-stack business management platform and corporate website for a wedding service provider.
longDescription: Built features to streamline business operations including customer management, booking tracking, service inquiries, and centralized business data management.
highlights: Built a full-stack business management platform and customer-facing corporate website for a wedding service provider.
Streamlined customer management, booking tracking, service inquiries, and centralized business data.
Implemented authentication and database operations with Supabase, deployed on Vercel with Cloudflare.
Delivered a cost-conscious solution that met the client's requirements within budget.

topics.architecture: Next.js frontend with Supabase backend, deployed on Vercel with Cloudflare routing.
topics.ai: No AI integration, focuses on operational efficiency.
topics.challenges: Balancing comprehensive feature requirements with the allocated budget to achieve a win-win scenario.

name: Transaction Name Generator & Comparison Tool
description: An automated tool to streamline transaction naming and comparison activities during performance testing.
longDescription: Developed an Excel VBA-based QA tool to automate transaction naming and streamline comparison activities during performance testing. Significantly reduced manual effort and improved consistency in data preparation.
highlights: Built an Excel VBA automation tool to generate transaction names and streamline comparison activities for performance testing.
Automated repetitive data-processing and validation tasks, reducing manual effort and improving consistency.
Designed the workflow to accelerate performance test data preparation and validation.

topics.architecture: Standalone Excel tool leveraging VBA Macros for rapid local processing.
topics.ai: Rule-based logic and macros, no external AI.
topics.challenges: Ensuring the macros remain performant and accurate when processing thousands of transaction entries.

name: SynOne Store
tagline: Modern storefront UI/UX with a component-driven design system
description: A modern e-commerce storefront focused on UI/UX, built as a front-end showcase with a polished browsing and cart experience.
longDescription: Built a modern storefront using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Motion, with Redux Toolkit for client-side state management. Focused on delivering a clean, responsive UI/UX across product browsing, filtering, and cart interactions. Implemented as a front-end only project without backend services such as payments or order processing.
highlights: Built a modern storefront UI/UX with a focus on responsive layout, visual hierarchy, and smooth interactions.
Managed cart and product state on the client using Redux Toolkit.
Added Motion-driven transitions and micro-interactions to create a polished browsing experience.
Implemented as a front-end showcase — no backend services such as payments or order processing.

topics.architecture: Next.js front end with Tailwind CSS for styling, Redux Toolkit for client-side state, and Motion for animation. Deployed on Vercel as a static front-end application with no backend layer.
topics.ai: No AI integration — the focus is purely on UI/UX and interaction design.
topics.stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Redux Toolkit.
topics.challenges: Creating a convincing storefront experience purely on the front end, which meant handling cart state and product data entirely on the client while keeping interactions feeling fast and natural.

name: Conversational Portfolio
tagline: AI-style interactive portfolio with intent-driven conversations
description: An interactive portfolio website designed as a conversational interface, allowing visitors to explore education, experience, projects, and contact information through chat and contextual quick actions.
longDescription: Built a conversational portfolio using Next.js and TypeScript, combining a chat-based interface with intent detection and state-driven navigation. Visitors can explore portfolio content through quick actions or natural-language messages, with contextual responses, project details, images, and suggested next actions. Designed with a static-first architecture to provide fast response times without requiring a traditional backend.
highlights: Built an interactive conversational portfolio that lets visitors explore professional experience and projects through a natural-language interface — so yes, you're reading its highlight list from inside itself.
Integrated intent-powered conversation to provide contextual responses about skills, projects, and technical experience.
Implemented intent-driven routing to understand user messages and navigate to relevant portfolio content.
Built contextual quick actions that allow users to progressively explore education, experience, projects, and contact information.
Used a static-first architecture to achieve fast response times without requiring a dedicated backend or database.

topics.architecture: Next.js and TypeScript frontend using a state-driven conversation engine, local portfolio data, and intent-based routing. Designed as a static-first application and deployed through a serverless/static hosting architecture.
topics.ai: Uses intent detection to interpret natural-language messages and map them to relevant portfolio sections and topics. The architecture is designed to support an external AI model for more advanced queries without making the core experience dependent on an AI API.
topics.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Intent Detection, Static Architecture, Cloudflare.
topics.challenges: Creating an AI-style conversational experience while keeping response times fast, minimizing infrastructure requirements, and ensuring that users can navigate naturally through both quick actions and free-text messages. Also: resisting the urge to make the bot talk about itself too much. You clearly found that button anyway.
